QUOTE: "`LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788-800`) passes the empty result through. It returns empty when no tokenizer is wired, with no log."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the backend wrapper passes through the empty result from a failed tokenization and also returns empty when no tokenizer is wired, so both cases give the same empty value.
